Capable of drawing conclusions and reconciling differences between predicted values and actual results.</p></li><li><p>Plans and coordinates the design and analysis of complex engineering solutions including documentation, reporting, publishing, and making technical or other presentations to ensure visibility of the solutions in an evolving environment.</p></li><li><p>Designs new equipment and machinery as conceived to support program and project needs. Assists in building, installing, debugging, and testing new equipment to ensure production capabilities.</p></li><li><p>Determines technical objectives and develops innovative, practical solutions to advance technical engineering problems. Provides technical support to failure investigations and bid responses. Leads technical efforts for design review activities.</p></li><li><p>Leads technical teams in design and analytical activities for product design and development and production.</p></li><li><p>Mentors less experienced engineers and is involved in development of their skills.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><b><span>What You Bring:</span></b></p><ul><li><p>Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering; advanced degree a plus.</p></li><li><p>10 years work experience dealing with manufacture and design of engineered products.</p></li><li><p>Experience with rotating equipment and machine designs (motors, pumps, generators and propulsors).</p></li><li><p>Finite Element Analysis, Computational Fluid Dynamics, GD&amp;T, CAD systems, CAE systems.</p></li><li><p>Ability to perform analysis and studies with strong attention to details in a fast-paced environment.</p></li><li><p>Ability to create models and drawings and perform trade studies and design reviews.
